name: Speedy
description: You and every enemy move faster.
_help: runScale: your speed on the ground (platformer, brawler). shipScale: your ship (shmup). Racer: runScale is your speed on the ground, enemyScale every rival. enemyScale: every enemy, and enemy shots in the shmup (brawler enemies also recover faster, but wind-ups stay readable). Jumps are never changed: in the air you move at normal speed. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine.
